title: Render and verify my worlds: every family, Time & Place eras, and worlds behind a thread
why: My worlds are data (src/core/worlds): families compose into layered worlds that the 3D and 2D adapters draw. After adding a family, a place or an era, or changing an adapter, render every family and run the acceptance in the real Thread. It needs Playwright's Chromium and the dev server on 5173 (or LELU_BASE). It spends nothing.
